message: Mike, I have a word document that is a table of the entire semester on one page. Every semester, I just fill in the dates for the months, and I type in the due dates for essays.  It helps to me to schedule, balance, and figure out when there may be those impossible days/weekends to plan something in my personal life.  I keep a copy in my academic planner, near the desk at home, and in the folder that I take to my traditional classes.
